Topic.label: Basic Straightedge and Compass Constructions: Copying an Angle and Constructing an Angle Bisector

Question: Construct an angle equal to a given angle using a straightedge and compass: mark off \(OC=OD=4\text{ cm}\) on the two sides of the given angle, and measure \(CD=3\text{ cm}\). On one side of the new angle, mark \(O'C'=4\text{ cm}\), then construct \(O'D'=4\text{ cm}\) and \(C'D'=CD\). What is the length of \(C'D'\) (in cm)?
Solution: When copying an angle, set \(C'D'=CD\), so the three pairs of corresponding sides are equal (SSS), and \(\triangle O'C'D'\cong\triangle OCD\). Thus, \(C'D'=3\).

Original.prompt: 用尺规作一个角等于已知角：在已知角两边上截取 OC=OD=4 cm，量得 CD=3 cm；在新角的一边上取 O'C'=4 cm，再作出 O'D'=4 cm，C'D'=CD，则 C'D' 的长是多少（单位：cm）？
Original.explanation: 作等角时使 C'D'=CD，这样三边对应相等（SSS），△O'C'D'≌△OCD，所以 C'D'=3。
